name: Yoga (all traditions)
notes: Root node for the tree

name: Pre-classical (Vedic; Upaniṣadic; Gītā)
emphasis: Tapas; breath; meditation; yoga as discipline and path
notes: Ṛgveda through Bhagavad Gītā

name: Classical (Sāṃkhya-Yoga / Patañjala)
emphasis: Eight limbs; puruṣa-prakṛti dualism; citta-vṛtti-nirodha
notes: Yoga Sūtras and Vyāsa's Bhāṣya

name: Tantric yoga
emphasis: Kuṇḍalinī; cakras; mantra; subtle body
notes: Śaiva and Śākta traditions

name: Haṭha yoga (premodern)
emphasis: Bandha; mudrā; prāṇāyāma; later āsana
notes: Nāth Siddha origins; Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā (c. 15th c.)

name: Modern yoga (c. 1890–present)
emphasis: Global; institutional; physical plus philosophical
notes: Modern postural yoga is largely a 20th-century hybrid (Singleton; De Michelis)

name: Vedānta societies (Vivekananda)
emphasis: Rāja Yoga as meditation; Advaita Vedānta; service
notes: Ramakrishna Mission lineage; little āsana

name: Kriya Yoga / Self-Realization
emphasis: Kriya technique; devotion; meditation
notes: Lahiri Mahasaya to Sri Yukteswar to Yogananda; SRF founded 1920

name: Integral Yoga (Aurobindo)
emphasis: Psychological transformation; evolutionary spirituality
notes: Sri Aurobindo Ashram in Pondicherry; NOT the same as Satchidananda's Integral Yoga

name: Scientific and institutional yoga
emphasis: Physiology research; therapy; moderate āsana
notes: Kaivalyadhama; The Yoga Institute

name: Krishnamacharya lineage (Mysore)
emphasis: Vinyāsa; breath; adaptation to the individual
notes: Source of the most influential postural schools

name: Ashtanga Vinyasa
emphasis: Fixed series; ujjāyī breath; bandhas; dṛṣṭi; Mysore-style teaching
notes: Primary; Intermediate; Advanced series

name: Iyengar Yoga
emphasis: Precise alignment; props; held postures; sequencing
notes: Light on Yoga (1966); Pune institute (1975)

name: Viniyoga
emphasis: Individualized practice; breath-led movement; therapy
notes: Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram; Gary Kraftsow's Viniyoga America

name: Indra Devi style
emphasis: Gentle accessible hatha for general students
notes: First Western woman student of Krishnamacharya

name: Power Yoga and Vinyasa Flow
emphasis: Dynamic Western flow derived from Ashtanga
notes: Birch's Power Yoga (1995); Baptiste; many studio flow styles

name: Sivananda lineage
emphasis: Integrated yoga: service; devotion; knowledge; meditation
notes: Divine Life Society in Rishikesh

name: Sivananda Yoga (Vishnudevananda)
emphasis: Five points: exercise; breathing; relaxation; diet; positive thinking and meditation; 12 basic postures
notes: Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres

name: Integral Yoga (Satchidananda)
emphasis: Easy gentle hatha with raja; karma; bhakti; jñāna; japa
notes: Different from Aurobindo's Integral Yoga; Yogaville

name: Bihar School of Yoga (Satyananda)
emphasis: Yoga nidrā; kriyā; systematic training
notes: Based in Munger; Bihar

name: Siddha Yoga (Muktananda)
emphasis: Śaktipāt; kuṇḍalinī awakening; Kashmir Śaivism flavor
notes: Nityananda lineage (not Sivananda)

name: Himalayan Institute (Swami Rama)
emphasis: Rāja and tantra; meditation; research on voluntary control
notes: Swami Rama took part in Menninger Foundation research in the early 1970s

name: Kundalini Yoga (Yogi Bhajan)
emphasis: Kriyās; breath of fire; mantra; 3HO
notes: Widely taught; founder is the subject of documented misconduct allegations

name: Kripalu Yoga
emphasis: Postures as meditation; yoga of consciousness; surrender
notes: Kripalu Center (Massachusetts); Amrit Desai resigned in 1994 amid misconduct revelations

name: Ghosh lineage and Hot Yoga (Bikram)
emphasis: Physical culture; fixed 26-posture heated sequence
notes: Ghosh's college in Calcutta (1923); Bikram Yoga branded in the 1970s; founder lost civil judgments

name: Transcendental Meditation
emphasis: Mantra meditation; no āsana; global organization
notes: Maharishi; Beatles visit 1968

name: Western hybrid and therapeutic styles
emphasis: Blends of the above with Western fitness and psychology
notes: Studio-era styles

name: Jivamukti
emphasis: Vinyāsa; chanting; activism; scripture
notes: Ashtanga and Sivananda influences; New York

name: Anusara
emphasis: Alignment principles plus tantric non-dual philosophy
notes: Founder stepped back in 2012 amid scandal

name: Yin Yoga
emphasis: Long passive holds; connective tissue focus; Taoist influences
notes: Zink (Taoist yoga); Grilley (anatomy); Sarah Powers

name: Restorative Yoga
emphasis: Props; long supported holds; nervous system rest
notes: Iyengar-derived; Judith Hanson Lasater (Relax and Renew; 1995)

name: Forrest Yoga
emphasis: Intense core work; breath; emotional release
notes: Ana Forrest
